subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should OpenClaw add one-way A2A handoff as an explicit `sessions_send` mode, as a separate delivery primitive, or defer it while only fixing narrower reverse-call and announce bugs?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes model-facing A2A/session semantics and can affect existing coordination workflows, so automation should not choose the permanent public API shape.

options.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a clearly named one-way mode while preserving current conversation behavior as the default, with docs and tests for both modes.

options.title: Create a separate primitive
options.body: Add a `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue` style tool so one-way delivery cannot be confused with conversational `sessions_send`, accepting a larger model-facing tool surface.

options.title: Defer dispatch semantics
options.body: Keep only the current conversation lifecycle for now and handle narrower reverse-call or announce bugs through their existing canonical issues and PRs.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a clearly named one-way mode while preserving current conversation behavior as the default, with docs and tests for both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined signal from current sessions_send history, adjacent handoff comments, and product/API ownership of this surface.
